qualifierLegend.value: Reported numeric value, including explicit zero. Parentheses preserve estimated status.
qualifierLegend.trace: MEXT Tr: trace amount; not converted to zero or not detected.
qualifierLegend.missing: Blank, dash, absent table, or incompatible mapping. Does not prove biological absence.

mappingNotes.carb: MEXT CHOAVL: available carbohydrate mass (main column 15). Total by difference and monosaccharide equivalents remain separate extras.
mappingNotes.vA: Not mapped: MEXT reports RAE; Happy Meal BLS key uses retinol equivalents. Source RAE retained as extra.
mappingNotes.vE: Not mapped: MEXT alpha-tocopherol is retained separately; not silently mapped to vitamin E equivalents.
mappingNotes.b3: Niacin, not niacin equivalents. Niacin equivalents retained as extra.
mappingNotes.b9: Reported food folate, not dietary folate equivalents.
mappingNotes.aa: Amino-acid composition per 100g food: mg converted to g.
mappingNotes.cys_: Not mapped: MEXT cystine is retained as a separate property; app standard field is labelled cysteine.
mappingNotes.epa_dpa_dha: EPA, DPA n-3 and DHA retained in mg; other mapped fatty acids in g.
mappingNotes.bcar: Beta-carotene µg converted to mg; beta-carotene equivalents not mixed in.
mappingNotes.sug: Total sugars not inferred; individual reported sugars imported.
mappingNotes.sourceRaw: All nonempty original workbook cells from column 4 onward, indexed from zero, for the same food code. Includes source-specific properties and Japanese notes.
